body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken, the session's reading which; words the dictation misheard corrected on the word, with what it wrote kept. After each, the essence of the session's answer in its own voice, the fuller answers written in the conversation and not kept. The work stands in bea76b5, a set checked as a set, and 008dd38, a fact asked once for all its bindings, a store's level by pattern from 466 to about 155 ms; in the wiki's rewrite for what was settled; and in the store's own commits. OpenLight's specs were read from a fresh clone, its engine, chassis, bootstrap, pilot and horizon, and the rule from its own repository. It began on 2026-11-10 and ran into 2026-11-11; a session has one day, as the thread Where a date belongs leaves it.
